roadmap.title: AI Report Card Comments
roadmap.summary: Generate teacher-style remarks per student using grade history + attendance. Editable, never auto-published.

roadmap.title: AI Fee Reminder Writer
roadmap.summary: Drafts fee-reminder messages in your school's tone — Hindi or English — based on the parent's history.

roadmap.title: WhatsApp Parent-Comms Summarizer
roadmap.summary: Long parent chat threads summarized into a one-paragraph briefing for the principal each morning.

roadmap.title: Dropout Risk Scoring
roadmap.summary: Flags students at risk based on attendance + fee delay + grade drop. Counsellor can intervene early.

roadmap.title: AI Admission Funnel Triage
roadmap.summary: Auto-classifies inbound admission inquiries by intent + fit + urgency. Counsellor opens the hottest leads first.

manifesto.headline: Admin-AI. Built for the people who run schools.
manifesto.body: We don't believe AI replaces a teacher. We believe AI removes the busywork that keeps a principal away from teachers. Every Friensys AI feature is admin-facing, optional, and always editable before it leaves the school.
